{{Quote|. First identification as Fixer Fifteen came during Operation: Red Cell (see listening post transcripts).|SIS dossier on Lokin|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Operation: Red Cell''' was a clandestine operation conducted by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] intelligence agency, during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]<ref name="Codex" /> between [[3681 BBY|3681]]&ndash;[[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> During the operation, SIS agents identified the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operative [[Fixer (Imperial Intelligence)|Fixer]] Fifteen as the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Eckard Lokin]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Operation: Free Cell was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Doctor Eckard Lokin in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
